by using a NIR dye that can transfer its energy to a second one, the latter can act as a quencher and reduce the amount of SO generated by ICG.

by encapsulating two dyes in a micelle we are able to increase the stability of IGC against photodecomposition and increase its phototherapeutic efficacy.
